Growth & demand: Headquartered in Ludhiana, Punjab, our business model operates as a vertically integrated, one-stop shop engineered to deliver custom solutions for the most demanding global engineering environments.
Continuously seeking better engineering methods, expanding tool room capabilities, and adapting swiftly to custom demands.

More importantly, the year demonstrated the strategic principle we have followed for four decades: we grew our revenue while consciously reducing the tonnage we shipped - choosing value per kilogram over volume for its own sake.
Margins & costs: The reason is a deliberate shift in what we choose to make: average realisation improved from ₹98.6 per kg to ₹117.0 per kg, a gain of 18.6%.
